clauses.quote: No Title II, Part A or Title I, Part A funds shall be used to pay the salary of any teacher or paraprofessional (except under NCLBA Section 2141(c)(2)) who does not meet the NCLBA and State definitions of a "highly qualified" teacher.
clauses.subject_text: No Title II, Part A or Title I, Part A funds
clauses.notes: Funding restriction for compliance; restricts district use of federal funds.

clauses.quote: Outside employment shall not interfere with the proper exercise of professional duties and responsibilities to the Board.
clauses.notes: Regulates worker conduct outside district employment.

clauses.quote: No activities related to outside employment may be performed during regular work hours.
clauses.subject_text: No activities related to outside employment
clauses.notes: Restricts worker use of district time for external work.

clauses.quote: Upon the recommendation of the Superintendent, a tenured teacher or other employees designated by the Birmingham City Schools may, on request, be granted a one-year leave of absence without payment of salary.
clauses.subject_text: a tenured teacher or other employees designated by the Birmingham City Schools
clauses.notes: Grants workers discretionary access to unpaid leave.

clauses.quote: For valid reasons, additional leave of one-year may be granted upon written request and appropriate approval if requested prior to the end of the first year's leave of absence.
clauses.notes: Management retains discretion to extend unpaid leave subject to approval.

clauses.quote: Leave shall be granted for jury duty, court subpoenaed witnessing, and other legal obligations as approved by the superintendent.
clauses.notes: Mandates management to approve leave for specified legal duties.

clauses.quote: Salary shall be continued at the regular rate.
clauses.notes: Mandates continued pay during the approved legal leave period.

clauses.quote: School system related litigation and jury duty shall be with pay.
clauses.subject_text: School system related litigation and jury duty
clauses.notes: Specifies compensation status for district-related legal duties.

clauses.quote: Funds received for serving, as a juror in state and federal Court shall be retained by the juror.
clauses.subject_text: Funds received for serving, as a juror in state and federal Court
clauses.notes: Grants workers permission to keep jury pay rather than remitting it to the district.
